## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (96%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1], high reliability, and clear frozen-section margins [F7] despite severity-3 stain degradation.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 96%, Normal 2%, InSitu 2%, Invasive 0% | Strongly favors benign (0% invasive) |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (alpha 0.1, 90% coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 76% OOD [F6] | Unflagged despite severity-3 stain degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Benign (80%, 88%–92% similarity) [F5] | Neighbors support benign call |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 4, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.59) [F2]; unreliable (0/20 spot check) · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 3, 4) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.55) [F3]; 20/20 spot check · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (-0.55, caption-inconsistent) [F4]; 18/20 spot check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (`risk_minus_random` +0.0114, CI 0.0021–0.0197 excludes 0); case tile risks 0–0.001.
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (`concept_minus_random` CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); uses unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 stain degradation on simulated frozen section masks atypia or invasion (error AUROC 0.70, test n=132).
- Superior-lateral corner (32% margin probability) harbors lesion, or tissue is Normal like contrast `BACH_0207` (91% similar).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 8**: Inspect nonzero risk tile (0.001), top invasion score (0.66), and unreliable lobule/mitosis calls.
2. **Region 3**: Check superior-lateral margin corner (`x=1792, y=0`) where involvement probability reaches 32%.
3. **Regions 2, 5, 10, 11**: Confirm benign tubules (`2, 10, 11`) and region `5` duct-confined atypia (0.90).
